verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents its own MCP server that connects AI chat clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to the same REST API, so an agent can pull live administration data. The evidence does not show which ledger or financial data the agent can reach: only contacts endpoints are documented, and nothing covers balances, ledger accounts, cash position or reporting that an affordability answer would need. Missing for 10: documented ledger/balance/report endpoints exposed via MCP or API, evidence of financial-question answering grounded in live ledger data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API

citations.quote: Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any MCP client.
